chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from al-Ḥakam ibn Miskīn, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from a man, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
Surely We presented the Trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, but they refused to bear it and feared it, and the human being bore it; surely he was unjust, ignorant.
He said: "It is the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام."

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn; the title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.الْأَمَانَةَ: the Trust; the divine charge mentioned in the verse
key_terms.جَهُولًا: very ignorant; describing the human being in relation to the Trust
key_terms.ظَلُومًا: greatly unjust; describing the human being in relation to bearing the Trust
key_terms.وَلَايَةُ: the wilayah; divinely appointed authority and guardianship

ai.seo_question: What does the Trust in Qur'an 33:72 mean according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic "Trust" as the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام. It presents the verse as referring to a grave divine charge whose acceptance carries immense responsibility and consequence.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Al Hakam Bin Miskeen, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[33:72] Surely We Presented the Trust to the skies, and the earth, and the mountains, but they refused to bear it and feared from it, and the human being bore it; he was unjust, ignorant.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is the Wilayah of Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammara from a man from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious.

“We offered Our Trust (Our deputation) to the heavens, to the earth, and to the mountains, but they could not bear this burden and were afraid to accept it. Mankind was able to accept this offer but he was unjust to himself and ignorant of the significance of this Trust.” [33:72].
The Imam (a.s.) said, “It refers to Leadership with Divine Authority of Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.).”
